_comment: TalonMatch Definition of Done — Claude Code enforces these rules on every task.

aesthetic.name: Zen Minimalism
rules: NEVER use box-shadow utilities (shadow-sm, shadow-md, shadow-lg, shadow-xl). Use borders only.
All cards must use border-gray-100 or border-slate-200/60 as the resting border.
Card hover must trigger the clockwise green border-draw animation via the .job-card CSS class (color: #10B981).
Layout hierarchy and white-space references Glassdoor Web UI: generous padding, flat surfaces, restrained color.

logic.name: Test-First

match_score_rules.below_100: Card MUST list missing skills (requirements_array minus parsedResume.skills). Never say 'all skills found' when match_score < 100.
match_score_rules.exactly_100: Hide the missing-skills section. Show 'You match all listed requirements.'
match_score_rules.empty_requirements: When requirements_array is empty or undefined, show the percentage + 'Requirements may not be fully listed' copy — never falsely claim 100% or 'all skills found'.

automated_barrier: Write the Vitest test case BEFORE writing feature code.
Run npm test (from frontend/) after every refactor.
Only present code once ALL tests are green.

dates.rule: ALL postedAt ISO strings must be transformed to relative strings via formatRelativeTime (e.g. '1w ago', '3d ago'). Raw ISO strings must never appear in the UI.
dates.fallback: If postedAt is null/undefined, render nothing — do not show a raw date or placeholder.

pdf_parsing.error_toast: Analysis taking longer than expected. Please try a smaller PDF.
pdf_parsing.rule: Every /api/match fetch call must be wrapped in an AbortController with a 15-second timeout.
